mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, IFNULL(SUM(is_passed = 1), 0) AS passed, IFNULL(SUM(is_passed = 0), 0) AS failed, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(cost_time), 1), 0) AS avg_cost_time, IFNULL(SUM(DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()), 0) AS today_total, IFNULL(SUM(DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_passed = 1), 0) AS today_passed, IFNULL(SUM(DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_passed = 0), 0) AS today_failed FROM captcha_verify_record
